checkedAlternates.risk: Diffie-Hellman uses public/private key pairs like RSA.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Diffie-Hellman is specifically a key-agreement protocol (group-1), not a signature or encryption scheme.
MD5 is still structurally a cryptographic hash function (group-4).
